text: Lansdown Bridge Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Lansdown Bridge Type: Monument - Bridge Province: Sindh District: Sukkur Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1857 - 1947 CE Description: This historical bridge was built during the British period in 1887. It was designed by Sir A.M. Rendel. Its total span is 277 m. It is still in fairly good condition.
